title: Sales agent: recommended lead and opportunity actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: Hold: Microsoft now documents two licensing options for Sales agent, so the unpublished-entitlement statement and older licensing quotation need correction. Microsoft also documents a Dataverse API for enabling recommended actions for a source agent, contrary to the automation gap reported here. The roadmap status, target and on-by-default statement match the record.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing is unknown and not yet published for this roadmap item.
claims.quote: To use Sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, you must meet one of the following licensing options: ... Dynamics 365 Sales Enterprise or Premium access, without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license | CRM data only
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. State: 'Sales agent requires either an appropriate Microsoft 365 Copilot license and access to Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce, for CRM data and Microsoft 365 Graph grounding, or Dynamics 365 Sales Enterprise or Premium access without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, for CRM data only. Any additional entitlement or metering specific to these recommended actions is not yet published.' Use https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-sales-copilot/set-up-sales-chat. Replace the blanket unpublished-licensing statements in the notes, body and cost rationale with the narrower additional-entitlement caveat; retain cost low for the known preparation work.
